notes:
A compound of {減|げん} (reduce) and {塩|えん} (salt). Very common in health and food contexts in Japan, where traditional cuisine tends to be high in sodium. Frequently seen on food packaging as a product label.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {減塩|げんえん}⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧: low-salt soy sauce
- {減塩|げんえん}⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧: low-salt miso
- {減塩|げんえん}{食|しょく}: low-salt diet
- {減塩|げんえん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: low-salt lifestyle
- {減塩|げんえん}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: salt-reduction measures

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese dietary guidelines recommend salt reduction because traditional foods like miso soup, pickles, and soy sauce are high in sodium. Low-salt versions of these staples are widely available in supermarkets.

definitions.explanation: reducing salt intake or salt content, especially in food or diet; low-salt as a product descriptor
